profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly accomplished software engineer with over 15 years of experience at the head of major development projects for global technology corporations, with primary focus on building enterprise applications for the health care and insurance industry. Exceptional abilities throughout all stages of the software development lifecycle, with key involvement from GAPs analyses, writing requirement specifications and technical specifications, implementation through User Acceptance Test (UAT). Able to work with stakeholders to manage requirements and expectations. Skilled at design multi-layered systems architectures, layered solutions and object oriented design. Developed in Java / J2EE to build robust, flexible, highly responsive applications.

•	Languages: Java, C#, C / C++, XML, UML, SQL, JavaScript
•	Web: J2EE/JEE technologies (servlets, JSP, JDBC), Struts, Struts2, Spring MVC, Spring security, Spring AOP, Spring RESTfulweb services,ORM technologies (JPA, Hibernate) , EJB, HTML, CSS, JQuery, AJAX, Tiles
•	Databases: MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server
•	OSs: Windows, Linux
•	Source code control systems: Subversion (SVN), GIT,VSS
•	Building tools: maven
•	Continuous integration tools: Jira
•	SDLC:Waterfall, Iterative, Agile
•	Design patterns&Architectural patterns

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
ARM is a state-of-art company providing high-performance, high-quality, and low-power CPUs and Physical Libraries to world's leading chip and device. I am a part of the software development team developing and deploying state of the art software to streamline streamlining product definitions, product releases, product delivery, operational efficiencies, and royalty-revenue tracking in an efficient, automated manner, yet with high-quality.
•	Change architect of download manager from single thread to multiple threads
•	Design, develop and improve performance for web services
•	Enhance security features
•	Develop proof of concept for new GUI
Environments: Python, Django, Celery, Java, JPA, Rest, MySQL, AWS (DynamoDB, SQS, S3, etc.), Docker, gRPC
positions.insights: Web Experience, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +17 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tillster simplifies digital ordering, improves customer engagement and grows sales. Tillster helped launch the digital ordering industry with an unrivaled knowledge of large multi-unit restaurants.
•	Refactoring Tillster platform, dividing a big system into smaller sub systems which provide unique purpose such as payment user services, ordering services, etc.
•	Coded filters to authenticate, authorize at both server side and client side.
•	Design and develop APIs for external/internal call for BK project and platform.
•	Developed promotion service provides features such as validation, redemption, cancel redemptions.
•	Last but not least, draw UML diagrams and create documents for existing/new features.
Environments: Java/JEE, CXF, Jersey, Spring projects, JPA, hibernate, UML, SQL, Junit, Mockito, Liquibase, MySQL, RabbitMQ, GIT, memcached, IntellJ.
positions.insights: Web Experience, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +16 skills

positions.title: Full task
positions.description:
  Iselect-Life: A web-based application for core life insurance system, designed as a table-oriented system for flexibility. System featured real-time changes to factors; web page workflow events; run-time security changes; and, XML to simply, quickly add custom fields or newly configured tables. Programmed in Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST, Hibernate, Tiles, JQuery, and Bootstrap.

 Iselect-CodeGen: A code generation function for interfaces and implementing classes, with entity, model, and DTO classes, Hibernate file mapping, and DAO class repository from excel Data Dictionary (DD). Programmed in Core Java, String Template, and JOpenDocument.
positions.insights: Web Experience, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +17 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
CSC is a Fortune 500 company, Vietnam center is the third largest development center of CSC in the world. 
	Responsibilities
•	Provided and implemented technical consulting on complex to highly complex projects and devises or modifies procedures to solve medium to highly complex problems.
•	Provided guidance and direction for development team members. 
	Achievements
•	Implemented converting tool to port Integral system being an insurance system from COBOL to java helps decreasing 70% porting time of team 10 people.
•	Revised java code to improve 30% of performance and decrease 20% of used memory of the system.
•	Worked directly with clients being insurance companies to get requirements and provide technical solutions for customization on Life/Asia system.
•	R&D Challenge Award – Consolation Prize issued by CSC Vietnam
•	Certificate of Appreciation, Global Award & Client issued by CSC Global for high performance
	Environments: Java, COBOL, Spring projects, SOAP, RESTfull, AOP, Java concurrency, JPA, UML, Oracle, MS Sql, JBoss, Netbeans, Log4J, JUnit, SVN, Jira, Window, Maven.
positions.insights: Web Experience, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +17 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
It is a startup company focusing on providing services over the internet. It provided B2B and B2C web applications at gophatdat.com domain. The web-based applications became the largest B2B web page in Vietnam. Tien Phong had gotten an adventured investment from VinaCapital, and its value was estimated around 5 million dollars by Alibaba when the company performing to invest to Tien Phong.
	Responsibilities
•	Designed and implemented a framework called Tigerton to build web applications with model layer capable of reading a data dictionary (excel file) to automatically generate mapping files and entity classes, with transparent DBMS connections.
•	Analyzed requirements, designed layers of systems, class diagrams, coding, debugging and testing the systems.
•	Designed and Developed web-based applications
•	Recruited and trained technical members, and built up development team. 
•	Responsible for quality assurance review. Provides coaching and guidance to team.
•	Deployed, Monitored and Maintained the applications. 
•	Enhanced and Continuous Improved the applications
•	Performed SEO, and Used Google Analysis and Alexa to monitor number of accessing and performance.
	Achievements
•	Decreased time of technical documentation by 50% by using Tigerton framework.
•	Decreased development and training time by 30%
•	Designed and developed web-based applications which ran faster 75% others web pages as Alexa’s report.
•	Designed and implemented a B2B website was the largest B2B website in Vietnam.
	Environments: Java, J2EE, Spring projects, Struts, REST, SOAP, AOP, JDBC, Tiles, GWT, javascript, UML, XML, JOpenDocument, Solr, Lucene, SVN, MySql, RedHat, Netbeans, Google Analysis, Alexa tools.
positions.insights: Web Experience, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and +16 skills
